```{r setup, include=FALSE}
## =====================================================================
##  EXECUTIVE DECK - Indonesia CVD / FAIR Choices analysis
##  World Bank * University of Washington
##
##  DATA PROVENANCE (BCA-free; no Excel recalculation required)
##  Every displayed number is imported programmatically from the modeling
##  pipeline's current-run outputs:
##    * output/09_deck_results.rds - the BCA-FREE results contract written by
##      code/cvd-fair-choices/09_cost_value.R. It carries, per workbook family
##      and scenario, the SAME R-engine values the workbooks store: deaths
##      averted, incremental cost, cost per death averted, 2050 death levels and
##      % reduction, and CVD 40q30 (level, baseline, % reduction). Scenario
##      identity/labels/order follow the Scenario_Catalog contract, which honours
##      the binding Intervention_Cause_Map include_flag - excluded interventions
##      never appear.
##    * the combined workbook's literal CVD_40q30 per-year sheet (cvd_40q30_r),
##      used only for the trajectory figure and the baseline 40q30 scalars.
##    * data/raw/03_asean_cvd_40q30_comparison.csv (international comparator).
##  NOTHING is transcribed by hand. The deck reads only stored/literal values,
##  so it compiles WITHOUT Excel COM and on a clean non-Windows environment. It
##  displays NO benefit-cost / VSL / VSLY content; the value-for-money metric is
##  COST PER DEATH AVERTED (in market US$). The full benefit-cost analysis lives
##  in the pipeline workbooks and is intentionally not shown here.
##
##  2026 REFRESH (executive/plain-language pass):
##    * Every content-slide title is a plain-language takeaway; the metric
##      formerly labelled "40q30" is written as "Probability of death from CVD
##      before age 70" in ALL rendered text (internal object/sheet/column names
##      such as CVD_40q30 / cvd_40q30_r are kept in code only).
##    * Every analytical slide carries a muted italic Source/Method footnote
##      (\srcmethod macro, defined in header-includes); cost/CE slides also carry
##      the fixed BPJS/MOH validation caveat (\costcaveat).
##    * Each of the three CE slides shows TWO discounted per-capita cost measures,
##      each drawn from / reconstructed from that family's OWN cost workbook
##      (Budget_Impact population is authoritative; the combined workbook is never
##      a shortcut for the clinical or public-health tables):
##        (1) Average annual additional cost per capita, 2026-2050
##              = cumulative DISCOUNTED additional cost 2026-2050
##                / (25 x 2026 population)              [parentheses essential]
##        (2) Additional cost per capita in 2050 at target coverage
##              = discounted additional cost in 2050 / 2050 population.
##      The clinical workbook is Excel-recalculated (cached) and read directly; the
##      public-health and combined formula workbooks are UNcached, so their annual
##      discounted additional cost is reproduced in R from the SAME Annual_Cost
##      inputs the workbook formulae use and reconciled to the run's contract total.
##      No Excel COM is required.
##    * The national cascade sub-section additionally reports the year-specific
##      annual additional cost per capita (cascade workbook, Budget_Impact).
##    * A two-panel stacked clinical budget-impact figure (2025-2050) decomposes
##      cumulative discounted total and per-capita cost by clinical intervention,
##      read from the clinical workbook Annual_Cost and QA-reconciled by year.
##    * The isolated 70-30-30 -> 70-70-70 cascade strategy is read ONLY from its
##      cascade workbook (national under output/70_30_30_to_70_70_70/; SUBNATIONAL
##      38-province under output/70_30_30_to_70_70_70_subnational/); never merged
##      into the ordinary results contract.
##    * A high-level DCP costing-methods slide + an appendix of the adapted
##      equations cite Watkins et al. (2020).
## =====================================================================
library(here)
library(data.table)
library(openxlsx)
library(ggplot2)
library(ggrepel)
library(scales)
library(knitr)
library(kableExtra)

knitr::opts_chunk$set(
  echo = FALSE, message = FALSE, warning = FALSE,
  fig.align = "center", dev = "cairo_pdf"
)

## ---- Palette (matches beamer_preamble.tex scenario colours) ---------------
col_clinical  <- "#3B6FB6"  # clinical scenarios
col_ph        <- "#1B9E77"  # public-health scenarios
col_combined  <- "#08306B"  # combined package (darker)
col_baseline  <- "#6E6E6E"  # baseline / status quo
col_comparator<- "#BDBDBD"  # comparator countries (muted)
col_incidence <- "#2166AC"  # incidence (Well -> Sick) effects
col_casefatal <- "#B2182B"  # case-fatality (Sick -> Death) effects
col_bgmort    <- "#7F7F7F"  # background mortality
col_wbnavy    <- "#0F2A56"

theme_exec <- function(base = 11) {
  theme_minimal(base_size = base) +
    theme(
      plot.title       = element_text(face = "bold", size = base + 1, colour = col_wbnavy),
      plot.subtitle    = element_text(colour = "grey35", size = base - 2),
      plot.caption     = element_text(colour = "grey45", size = base - 4, hjust = 0),
      panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
      panel.grid.major.x = element_blank(),
      legend.position  = "bottom",
      legend.title     = element_blank(),
      axis.title       = element_text(size = base - 2)
    )
}

## ---- Number formatters (LaTeX-safe: escaped $ and % ; used with escape=FALSE)
fmt_int   <- function(x) formatC(round(x), format = "d", big.mark = ",")
fmt_thou  <- function(x) ifelse(is.na(x), "--", formatC(round(x / 1000) * 1000, format = "d", big.mark = ","))
fmt_short <- function(x, acc = 0.1) ifelse(is.na(x), "--", label_number(scale_cut = cut_short_scale(), accuracy = acc)(x))
fmt_pct   <- function(x, d = 1) ifelse(is.na(x), "--", paste0(formatC(x, format = "f", digits = d), "\\%"))
fmt_usd   <- function(x) ifelse(is.na(x), "--", paste0("US\\$", formatC(round(x), format = "d", big.mark = ",")))
fmt_usd_short <- function(x) ifelse(is.na(x), "--", paste0("US\\$", fmt_short(x)))
## Per-capita US$ to 2 decimals (LaTeX-safe: escaped $).
fmt_usd_pc <- function(x) ifelse(is.na(x), "--", paste0("US\\$", formatC(x, format = "f", digits = 2, big.mark = ",")))
## Per-capita US$ with ADAPTIVE precision so small public-health costs never show as
## $0.00: >=1 -> 2dp; >=0.1 -> 2dp; >=0.01 -> 3dp; else 4dp. Keeps big values clean
## while preserving 2+ significant figures for cents-scale policy costs.
fmt_usd_pc2 <- function(x) {
  vapply(x, function(v) {
    if (is.na(v)) return("--")
    a <- abs(v)
    d <- if (a >= 0.1 || a == 0) 2L else if (a >= 0.01) 3L else 4L
    paste0("US\\$", formatC(v, format = "f", digits = d, big.mark = ","))
  }, character(1))
}
## Title-safe (plain-text, NO % or $ so it survives pandoc -> \frametitle):
## express a count in the most readable unit ("3.5 million", "1.13 million").
fmt_title_num <- function(x, acc = 0.1) {
  if (is.na(x)) return("--")
  if (abs(x) >= 1e6) return(paste0(formatC(x / 1e6, format = "f", digits = 1), " million"))
  if (abs(x) >= 1e3) return(paste0(formatC(round(x / 1e3), format = "d", big.mark = ","), " thousand"))
  formatC(round(x), format = "d", big.mark = ",")
}
## USD in billions/millions as plain words (no $) for prose reconciliation lines.
fmt_bn <- function(x, d = 2) ifelse(is.na(x), "--", paste0(formatC(x / 1e9, format = "f", digits = d), " billion"))
## Two-line table headers (converts embedded "\n" to \makecell line breaks).
mkhdr <- function(v) kableExtra::linebreak(v, align = "c")

## Null / NA coalescing helpers (base R has neither).
`%||%` <- function(a, b) if (is.null(a) || length(a) == 0L || (length(a) == 1L && is.na(a))) b else a
`%+na%` <- function(a, b) if (is.null(a) || length(a) == 0L || is.na(a[1])) b else a[1]
```

```{r xlsx-companion-setup, include=FALSE}
## =====================================================================
##  COMPANION EXCEL WORKBOOK  (reports/executive_slides.xlsx)
##  --------------------------------------------------------------------
##  A companion workbook is built programmatically AS THIS DECK KNITS.
##  Every figure/plot and every table that appears on a slide is captured
##  -- in slide order -- via reg_fig()/reg_tbl() at the exact point the
##  slide builds it, so the workbook reuses the SAME data objects and the
##  SAME plots the slides render. The workbook is assembled and written by
##  the final `build-xlsx-workbook` chunk at the end of the document.
##
##  Registration is INERT for the rendered deck:
##    * reg_tbl() returns its data invisibly -> emits nothing on the slide
##      (safe inside results='asis' chunks);
##    * reg_fig() saves the plot to PNG and RETURNS the ggplot, so the
##      figure chunk still auto-prints the identical figure to the deck.
##  A failure inside either helper is swallowed (the deck must still build).
## =====================================================================
.xlsx_enabled <- TRUE
.xlsx_items   <- list()
.xlsx_fig_dir <- file.path(tempdir(), "executive_slides_xlsx_figs")
dir.create(.xlsx_fig_dir, showWarnings = FALSE, recursive = TRUE)

## Register a table. `data` is the SAME object passed to kbl(); `col_names`
## the SAME display headers used on the slide (raw -- may carry LaTeX markup
## or embedded "\n"; both are cleaned to plain text at write time).
reg_tbl <- function(id, title, data, col_names = NULL, note = NULL) {
  if (!isTRUE(.xlsx_enabled)) return(invisible(data))
  try({
    .xlsx_items[[length(.xlsx_items) + 1L]] <<- list(
      kind = "table", id = id, title = as.character(title),
      data = as.data.frame(data, stringsAsFactors = FALSE),
      col_names = if (is.null(col_names)) NULL else as.character(col_names),
      note = note)
  }, silent = TRUE)
  invisible(data)
}

## Register a figure. Saves the ggplot to PNG at the slide's own dimensions
## and RETURNS the plot so the chunk auto-prints it into the deck unchanged.
reg_fig <- function(plot, id, title, width, height, dpi = 200, note = NULL) {
  if (!isTRUE(.xlsx_enabled)) return(plot)
  path <- file.path(.xlsx_fig_dir, paste0(id, ".png"))
  ok <- tryCatch({
    suppressWarnings(suppressMessages(
      ggplot2::ggsave(path, plot = plot, width = width, height = height,
                      units = "in", dpi = dpi, device = "png", bg = "white")))
    TRUE
  }, error = function(e) FALSE)
  try({
    .xlsx_items[[length(.xlsx_items) + 1L]] <<- list(
      kind = "figure", id = id, title = as.character(title),
      path = if (isTRUE(ok)) path else NA_character_,
      width = width, height = height, note = note)
  }, silent = TRUE)
  plot
}
```

```{r load-data, include=FALSE}
## ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
## 1. Resolve current-run inputs (project-relative) and check existence.
##    The deck reads a BCA-free R-side results contract + literal workbook
##    values only -- no Excel COM, no formula recalculation.
## ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
HZ_START <- 2025L; HZ_END <- 2050L

## Output directory: defaults to the project's output/, but can be redirected
## (e.g. for testing an alternative active-scenario subset) via EXEC_DECK_OUTDIR.
.out_dir <- Sys.getenv("EXEC_DECK_OUTDIR", unset = "")
outp <- if (nzchar(.out_dir)) function(f) file.path(.out_dir, f) else function(f) here("output", f)
deck_file <- outp("09_deck_results.rds")
wb_comb   <- outp("indonesia_model_cost_value_clinical_public_health_formulae.xlsx")
wb_clin   <- outp("indonesia_model_cost_value_formulae.xlsx")
wb_ph     <- outp("indonesia_cost_value_public_health_formulae.xlsx")
## Cached R-value companion to the clinical formula workbook: holds the SAME Model-09
## values as literals. Used for the clinical Budget_Impact when the formula workbook is
## written uncached (openxlsx default) so its computed cost cells read back as NA.
wb_clin_cached <- outp("indonesia_model_cost_value.xlsx")
csv_cmp   <- here("data", "raw", "03_asean_cvd_40q30_comparison.csv")

## Isolated 70-30-30 -> 70-70-70 cascade run (its OWN output dir; never merged with the
## ordinary results contract). Overridable for testing, defaults to the standard path.
.casc_dir <- Sys.getenv("EXEC_DECK_CASCADE_DIR", unset = "")
casc_wb <- if (nzchar(.casc_dir)) file.path(.casc_dir, "indonesia_70_30_30_to_70_70_70_cost_value_formulae.xlsx") else
  here("output", "70_30_30_to_70_70_70", "indonesia_70_30_30_to_70_70_70_cost_value_formulae.xlsx")

## Joint cascade + public-health run. Its CVD_40q30 sheet contains, among other
## scenarios, the hypertension/cholesterol + diabetes cascade (S_70_30_30_TO_70_70_70)
## and the cascade combined with the tobacco tax ONLY
## (S_70_30_30_TO_70_70_70_I_PH_TOBACCO_TAX) -- not the full tobacco regulatory
## package. Used by fig-40q30-cascade only.
.casc_ph_wb <- Sys.getenv("EXEC_DECK_CASCADE_PH_WB", unset = "")
casc_ph_wb <- if (nzchar(.casc_ph_wb)) .casc_ph_wb else
  outp("indonesia_model_cost_value_70_30_30_to_70_70_70_public_health_formulae.xlsx")

## Isolated SUBNATIONAL 70-30-30 -> 70-70-70 cascade run (38 provinces; its OWN output dir).
## The expected deliverable is the province-level formula workbook; overridable for testing.
.subnat_dir <- Sys.getenv("EXEC_DECK_SUBNAT_DIR", unset = "")
subnat_wb <- if (nzchar(.subnat_dir))
  file.path(.subnat_dir, "indonesia_70_30_30_to_70_70_70_cost_value_formulae_subnational.xlsx") else
  here("output", "70_30_30_to_70_70_70_subnational",
       "indonesia_70_30_30_to_70_70_70_cost_value_formulae_subnational.xlsx")

.req_files <- c(results_contract = deck_file, clinical_workbook = wb_clin,
                clinical_workbook_cached = wb_clin_cached,
                public_health_workbook = wb_ph, combined_workbook = wb_comb,
                comparator = csv_cmp, cascade_workbook = casc_wb,
                cascade_public_health_workbook = casc_ph_wb,
                subnational_workbook = subnat_wb)
.missing <- .req_files[!file.exists(.req_files)]
if (length(.missing))
  stop("VALIDATION STOP -- required input file(s) not found:\n  ",
       paste(sprintf("%s: %s", names(.missing), .missing), collapse = "\n  "),
       "\nRun the modeling pipeline (code/cvd-fair-choices/00_run_model_cvd_fair.R) first.",
       call. = FALSE)

rd        <- function(path, sheet) as.data.table(openxlsx::read.xlsx(path, sheet = sheet))
sheets_of <- function(path) openxlsx::getSheetNames(path)

## ---- Results contract -----------------------------------------------------
dk   <- readRDS(deck_file)
res  <- as.data.table(dk$results)
meta <- dk$meta

met_clin <- res[workbook == "clinical"]
met_ph   <- res[workbook == "public_health"]
met_comb <- res[workbook == "combined"]

## ---- Costing/report metadata (BCA-free: cost side only) -------------------
disc_rate  <- suppressWarnings(as.numeric(meta$cost_discount_rate)); if (!is.finite(disc_rate)) disc_rate <- 0.03
price_year <- suppressWarnings(as.numeric(meta$cost_price_year));    if (!is.finite(price_year)) price_year <- 2023
ce_unit    <- meta$cost_effectiveness_unit %||% "USD per death averted"
## LaTeX-safe escaper for dynamic strings inserted into prose with escape=FALSE.
ltx <- function(s) {
  s <- as.character(s)
  s <- gsub("\\\\", "\\\\textbackslash{}", s)
  s <- gsub("([&%$#_{}])", "\\\\\\1", s)
  s <- gsub("~", "\\\\textasciitilde{}", s)
  s
}
cost_perspective <- ltx(gsub("_", " ", meta$economic_perspective %||% "health system"))
```

```{r derive-scenarios, include=FALSE}
## ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
## 2. Scenario identity is DERIVED from the contract / Scenario_Catalog, never
##    from fixed ID vectors. Optional presentation-only label overrides may be
##    supplied; any active scenario without an override falls back safely to its
##    workbook label. No excluded / hard-coded ID is ever required to exist.
## ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
exec_label_override <- c(
  I_CVD_PRIMARY = "Primary CVD prevention", I_T2D_TREATMENT = "Type-2 diabetes treatment",
  I_IHD_SECONDARY = "Heart-attack secondary prevention", I_HF_CHRONIC = "Chronic heart-failure care",
  I_HF_ACUTE = "Acute heart-failure care", I_STROKE_SECONDARY = "Stroke secondary prevention",
  I_RHD_SECONDARY = "RHD secondary prevention", I_RHD_SURGERY = "RHD surgery",
  all = "All clinical (combined)",
  I_PH_TOBACCO_TAX = "Tobacco tax", I_PH_TOBACCO_POLICY = "Tobacco policy package",
  I_PH_SALT_POLICY = "Sodium policy package", I_PH_TFA_POLICY = "Trans-fat elimination",
  all_public_health = "All public health (combined)",
  all_clinical_public_health = "Clinical + public health (combined)",
  baseline = "Status quo (baseline)")

## Family aggregate / joint scenario ids (present only if built this run).
clin_all_id <- "all"; ph_all_id <- "all_public_health"; joint_id <- "all_clinical_public_health"
has_clin  <- nrow(met_clin[scenario != "baseline"]) > 0
has_ph    <- nrow(met_ph[scenario != "baseline"])   > 0
has_joint <- joint_id %in% met_comb$scenario

## Label getter: override first, else the contract's own scenario_label.
lbl <- function(sc, tab = met_comb) {
  if (sc %in% names(exec_label_override)) return(exec_label_override[[sc]])
  v <- tab[scenario == sc, scenario_label]
  if (length(v) && !is.na(v[1]) && nzchar(v[1])) v[1] else sc
}
## Metric getter.
hv <- function(sc, col, tab = met_comb) { v <- tab[scenario == sc][[col]]; if (length(v)) v[1] else NA_real_ }

## Top-level display rows for a family (exclude baseline and package CHILDREN to
## avoid double-counting; the family aggregate is placed last). Ordered by
## deaths averted. Robust to zero/one/many active interventions.
MAX_TBL_ROWS <- 14L
top_level_rows <- function(tab, agg_id) {
  if (!nrow(tab)) return(tab[0])
  d <- tab[scenario != "baseline" &
             (is.na(scenario_role) | !(scenario_role %in% c("child")))]
  if (!nrow(d)) return(d)
  d <- d[order(-deaths_averted)]
  agg <- d[scenario == agg_id]; rest <- d[scenario != agg_id]
  rbind(rest, agg)
}
```

```{r headline-scalars, include=FALSE}
## Baseline CVD 40q30 (per-year literal from the combined workbook).
c4c <- rd(wb_comb, "CVD_40q30")
qcol <- if ("cvd_40q30_r" %in% names(c4c)) "cvd_40q30_r" else "cvd_40q30"
base_q_2025 <- c4c[scenario == "baseline" & year == HZ_START][[qcol]][1]
base_q_2050 <- c4c[scenario == "baseline" & year == HZ_END][[qcol]][1]

## Combined-package (joint) headline metrics (guarded if joint absent).
combo_da   <- if (has_joint) hv(joint_id, "deaths_averted") else NA_real_
combo_cpda <- if (has_joint) hv(joint_id, "cost_per_death_averted") else NA_real_
combo_q50  <- if (has_joint) hv(joint_id, "cvd_40q30_2050") else NA_real_
combo_qred <- if (has_joint) hv(joint_id, "cvd_40q30_pct_reduction_2050") else NA_real_
combo_dred <- if (has_joint) hv(joint_id, "pct_reduction_deaths_2050") else NA_real_

clin_da   <- hv(clin_all_id, "deaths_averted", met_clin)
clin_qred <- hv(clin_all_id, "cvd_40q30_pct_reduction_2050", met_clin)
clin_cpda <- hv(clin_all_id, "cost_per_death_averted", met_clin)
ph_da     <- hv(ph_all_id, "deaths_averted", met_ph)
ph_qred   <- hv(ph_all_id, "cvd_40q30_pct_reduction_2050", met_ph)
ph_cpda   <- hv(ph_all_id, "cost_per_death_averted", met_ph)

## Most impactful single lever per family (excludes the aggregate).
.tc <- top_level_rows(met_clin, clin_all_id); .tc <- .tc[scenario != clin_all_id]
.tp <- top_level_rows(met_ph, ph_all_id);     .tp <- .tp[scenario != ph_all_id]
top_clin_sc <- if (nrow(.tc)) .tc$scenario[1] else NA_character_
top_ph_sc   <- if (nrow(.tp)) .tp$scenario[1] else NA_character_
```

```{r validation, include=FALSE}
## ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
## 3. VALIDATION GATES - health/cost-effectiveness contract only (NO BCA).
##    Consistency is checked against Scenario_Catalog + the results contract.
## ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
val_stop <- function(cond, msg) if (!isTRUE(cond)) stop("VALIDATION STOP - ", msg, call. = FALSE)

## (a) Scenario_Catalog present in every workbook that exists (health/CE contract;
##     Benefit_Cost / Economic_Value are NOT required by the deck).
cat_sets <- list()
.wb_paths <- c(clinical = wb_clin, public_health = wb_ph, combined = wb_comb)
for (fam in names(.wb_paths)) {
  path <- .wb_paths[[fam]]
  if (!file.exists(path)) next
  sh <- sheets_of(path)
  val_stop("Scenario_Catalog" %in% sh,
           sprintf("workbook '%s' is missing the Scenario_Catalog sheet", basename(path)))
  val_stop(all(c("CVD_40q30", "Cost_Effectiveness") %in% sh),
           sprintf("workbook '%s' is missing a required health/CE sheet", basename(path)))
  cat_sets[[fam]] <- rd(path, "Scenario_Catalog")$scenario
}

## (b) Contract scenario set reconciles EXACTLY with Scenario_Catalog per family
##     (no stale extras, nothing dropped). This is how "no excluded id sneaks in"
##     is enforced without hard-coding any excluded id.
recon_family <- function(cat_key, tab) {
  cs <- cat_sets[[cat_key]]
  if (is.null(cs)) return(invisible())
  ts <- unique(tab$scenario)
  val_stop(setequal(cs, ts),
           sprintf("%s: results contract scenarios do not match Scenario_Catalog. Only in catalog: {%s}; only in results: {%s}. Re-run Model 09 on the current run.",
                   cat_key, paste(setdiff(cs, ts), collapse = ", "),
                   paste(setdiff(ts, cs), collapse = ", ")))
}
recon_family("clinical", met_clin)
recon_family("public_health", met_ph)
recon_family("combined", met_comb)

## (c) baseline available exactly once per family + 2050 present.
for (tab in list(met_clin, met_ph, met_comb)) {
  if (!nrow(tab)) next
  val_stop(sum(tab$scenario == "baseline") <= 1, "baseline appears more than once in a family")
}
val_stop(any(c4c$scenario == "baseline") && HZ_END %in% c4c$year,
         "combined workbook CVD_40q30 has no baseline / no year 2050")

## (d) unique scenario ids within each family (no duplicates).
for (tab in list(met_clin, met_ph, met_comb))
  if (nrow(tab)) val_stop(!any(duplicated(tab$scenario)),
                          "duplicate scenario id within a family results block")

## (e) headline health/CE metrics finite where the scenario exists.
if (has_joint)
  val_stop(is.finite(combo_da) && is.finite(combo_q50) && is.finite(combo_cpda),
           "combined-package headline metrics are missing/non-numeric")
val_stop(is.finite(base_q_2050), "baseline CVD 40q30 in 2050 is missing")
```

```{r fig-40q30-data, include=FALSE}
## Data for the CVD 40q30 time-series & international-comparison figure.
cmp <- fread(csv_cmp)
cmp[, year := as.integer(year)]
comparators <- c("Malaysia","Philippines","Singapore","Thailand","Viet Nam","Indonesia")

                 .(country_label, year, q = q40q30_percent)][order(country_label, year)]
```

```{r national-cost-recon, include=FALSE}
## ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
## National per-capita cost measures - reconstructed from EACH family's OWN cost
## workbook, keyed by scenario (never the combined workbook as a shortcut).
##
## The two discounted measures shown in every national CE table are:
##   (1) Average annual additional cost per capita, 2026-2050 (discounted)
##         = [ cumulative DISCOUNTED additional cost over 2026-2050 ]
##           / ( 25 x 2026 population )            <-- parentheses are essential
##   (2) Additional cost per capita in 2050 at target coverage (discounted)
##         = discounted additional cost in 2050 / 2050 population
## Population is the workbook's own national_population (Budget_Impact), identical
## across scenarios by year; 2026 and 2050 are authoritative.
##
## Because openxlsx writes formula cells UNcached, the clinical workbook's
## Budget_Impact is fully Excel-recalculated (cached) and read directly, while the
## public-health and combined formula workbooks are uncached: their annual
## discounted additional cost is reproduced from the SAME authoritative Annual_Cost
## inputs the workbook formulae use, then reconciled to the run's contract total
## (disc_incremental_cost) to a tight relative tolerance. No Excel COM is required.
## ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
.ca_num <- function(path, id) {
  ca <- rd(path, "Calculation_Assumptions")
  v  <- suppressWarnings(as.numeric(ca[parameter_id == id, value][1])); v
}

## Cached clinical Budget_Impact resolver. The clinical formula workbook's Budget_Impact
## holds computed (formula) cost cells that are populated only when the workbook has been
## Excel-recalculated; when it is written uncached (openxlsx default) they read back as NA.
## In that case fall back to the companion R-value workbook, which stores the SAME Model-09
## R-engine values as literals, so the clinical family's discounted per-capita measures
## remain available without Excel COM.
read_clin_bi <- function() {
  bi <- rd(wb_clin, "Budget_Impact")
  if (!"disc_incremental_cost" %in% names(bi) || all(is.na(bi$disc_incremental_cost)))
    bi <- rd(wb_clin_cached, "Budget_Impact")
  bi
}
## Cached clinical Annual_Cost resolver (same fallback rationale as read_clin_bi). The
## R-value companion carries de-duplicated rows and no shared_duplicate_count column, so
## a missing/uncached count is treated as 1 (each component counted once, unweighted).
read_clin_ac <- function() {
  ac <- rd(wb_clin, "Annual_Cost")
  if (!"disc_cost_incremental" %in% names(ac) || all(is.na(ac$disc_cost_incremental)))
    ac <- rd(wb_clin_cached, "Annual_Cost")
  if (!"shared_duplicate_count" %in% names(ac) || all(is.na(ac$shared_duplicate_count)))
    ac[, shared_duplicate_count := 1]
  ac
}

## Annual discounted additional cost + national population, by (scenario, year).
build_annual_cost <- function(fam) {
  if (fam == "clinical") {
    ## Cached clinical Budget_Impact (formula workbook if recalculated, else R-value companion).
    bi <- read_clin_bi()
    need <- c("scenario","year","disc_incremental_cost","national_population","cumulative_disc_incremental_cost")
    val_stop(all(need %in% names(bi)), "clinical Budget_Impact missing required column(s)")
    ## Reconcile the annual series to the workbook's cumulative field, and confirm the
    ## 2026-2050 numerator equals cumulative[2050] - disc[2025] (2025 IS in the cumulative).
    .rc <- bi[, .(a = cumsum(disc_incremental_cost),
                  c = cumulative_disc_incremental_cost), by = scenario]
    val_stop(max(abs(.rc$a - .rc$c)) < 1,
             "clinical annual discounted cost does not reconcile to the cumulative field")
    .n1 <- bi[year %in% (HZ_START + 1L):HZ_END, .(num = sum(disc_incremental_cost)), by = scenario]
    .n2 <- bi[year == HZ_END, .(scenario, cum = cumulative_disc_incremental_cost)][
             bi[year == HZ_START, .(scenario, d25 = disc_incremental_cost)], on = "scenario"]
    .nn <- merge(.n1, .n2, by = "scenario")
    val_stop(max(abs(.nn$num - (.nn$cum - .nn$d25))) < 1,
             "clinical 2026-2050 numerator does not equal cumulative[2050] - 2025 value")
    out <- bi[, .(scenario, year, disc = disc_incremental_cost, pop = national_population)]
  } else if (fam == "public_health") {
    ## Uncached: reproduce annual policy-implementation cost from Annual_Cost inputs.
    r  <- .ca_num(wb_ph, "cost_discount_rate");  y0 <- .ca_num(wb_ph, "analysis_start_year")
    ps <- .ca_num(wb_ph, "policy_start_year");   rp <- .ca_num(wb_ph, "policy_cost_ramp_years")
    b0 <- .ca_num(wb_ph, "baseline_implementation_fraction")
    val_stop(all(is.finite(c(r, y0, ps, rp))), "public-health cost assumptions (rate/start/ramp) missing")
    if (!is.finite(b0)) b0 <- 0
    ac <- rd(wb_ph, "Annual_Cost")
    need <- c("scenario","year","pop_scenario","population_in_need_fraction","frequency_per_year","unit_cost_usd")
    val_stop(all(need %in% names(ac)), "public-health Annual_Cost missing required input column(s)")
    imf <- function(t) { f <- (t - (ps - 1)) / rp; f[t < ps] <- 0; pmin(pmax(f, 0), 1) }
    ac[, disc := pop_scenario * population_in_need_fraction * frequency_per_year * unit_cost_usd *
                 (imf(year) - b0) * (1 / (1 + r)^(year - y0))]
    a  <- ac[, .(disc = sum(disc)), by = .(scenario, year)]
    bi <- rd(wb_ph, "Budget_Impact")
    val_stop("national_population" %in% names(bi), "public-health Budget_Impact missing national_population")
    out <- merge(a, bi[, .(scenario, year, pop = national_population)], by = c("scenario","year"))
  } else if (fam == "combined") {
    ## Uncached: reproduce annual additional cost from Annual_Cost inputs.
    r  <- .ca_num(wb_comb, "cost_discount_rate"); y0 <- .ca_num(wb_comb, "analysis_start_year")
    val_stop(all(is.finite(c(r, y0))), "combined cost assumptions (rate/start) missing")
    ac <- rd(wb_comb, "Annual_Cost")
    need <- c("scenario","year","pin_fraction","frequency_per_year","unit_cost_usd",
              "q_scenario","q_baseline","covimpl_scenario","covimpl_baseline")
    val_stop(all(need %in% names(ac)), "combined Annual_Cost missing required input column(s)")
    ac[, disc := pin_fraction * frequency_per_year * unit_cost_usd *
                 (q_scenario * covimpl_scenario - q_baseline * covimpl_baseline) *
                 (1 / (1 + r)^(year - y0))]
    a  <- ac[, .(disc = sum(disc)), by = .(scenario, year)]
    bi <- rd(wb_comb, "Budget_Impact")
    val_stop("national_population" %in% names(bi), "combined Budget_Impact missing national_population")
    out <- merge(a, bi[, .(scenario, year, pop = national_population)], by = c("scenario","year"))
  } else stop("unknown family: ", fam)
  setorder(out, scenario, year)
  ## --- Structural validation ---------------------------------------------
  yrs <- sort(unique(out$year))
  val_stop(setequal(yrs, HZ_START:HZ_END),
           sprintf("%s cost workbook year coverage is not %d-%d", fam, HZ_START, HZ_END))
  ## national population identical across scenarios each year (single denominator)
  val_stop(nrow(out[, .(nu = uniqueN(pop)), by = year][nu > 1]) == 0,
           sprintf("%s national_population differs across scenarios within a year", fam))
  ## reconcile reconstructed full-horizon total to the run's contract total
  ct <- res[workbook == fam, .(scenario, contract = disc_incremental_cost)]
  rc <- merge(out[, .(tot = sum(disc)), by = scenario], ct, by = "scenario")
  rc[, rel := abs(tot - contract) / pmax(abs(contract), 1)]
  val_stop(nrow(rc) > 0 && max(rc$rel) < 1e-4,
           sprintf("%s reconstructed discounted cost does not reconcile to the contract total (max rel.diff %.2g)",
                   fam, if (nrow(rc)) max(rc$rel) else NA_real_))
  out[]
}
annual_cost_tabs <- list(
  clinical      = build_annual_cost("clinical"),
  public_health = build_annual_cost("public_health"),
  combined      = build_annual_cost("combined"))

## The two discounted per-capita measures for one (family, scenario).
DISPLAY_YEARS <- (HZ_START + 1L):HZ_END                 # 2026..2050
val_stop(length(DISPLAY_YEARS) == 25L,
         sprintf("expected exactly 25 years 2026-%d; got %d", HZ_END, length(DISPLAY_YEARS)))
pc_avg_annual <- function(fam, sc) {                    # measure (1)
  d <- annual_cost_tabs[[fam]][scenario == sc]
  if (!nrow(d)) return(NA_real_)
  num   <- d[year %in% DISPLAY_YEARS, sum(disc)]
  pop26 <- d[year == HZ_START + 1L, pop][1]
  if (!is.finite(num) || !is.finite(pop26) || pop26 <= 0) return(NA_real_)
  num / (25 * pop26)
}
pc_year2050 <- function(fam, sc) {                      # measure (2)
  d <- annual_cost_tabs[[fam]][scenario == sc]
  if (!nrow(d)) return(NA_real_)
  disc50 <- d[year == HZ_END, disc][1]; pop50 <- d[year == HZ_END, pop][1]
  if (!is.finite(disc50) || !is.finite(pop50) || pop50 <= 0) return(NA_real_)
  disc50 / pop50
}
## Independent validation: measure (2) for the clinical family must equal the
## clinical workbook's own cached disc_incremental_cost_per_capita in 2050.
{ .bi <- read_clin_bi()
  if ("disc_incremental_cost_per_capita" %in% names(.bi)) {
    .chk <- .bi[year == HZ_END, .(scenario, stored = disc_incremental_cost_per_capita)]
    .cmp <- merge(.chk, data.table(scenario = .chk$scenario,
                                   rebuilt = vapply(.chk$scenario, function(s) pc_year2050("clinical", s), numeric(1))),
                  by = "scenario")
    val_stop(max(abs(.cmp$stored - .cmp$rebuilt)) < 1e-6,
             "clinical 2050 per-capita reconstruction disagrees with the workbook's stored value") }
}
## Map contract workbook key -> the annual-cost family key (same names here).
fam_of <- function(tab) tab[1, workbook]
```

```{r results-builders, include=FALSE}
## Row builders for the impact / cost-effectiveness display tables (BCA-free).
impact_row <- function(tab, sc) data.table(
  Intervention = lbl(sc, tab),
  da  = fmt_thou(hv(sc, "deaths_averted", tab)),
  q50 = fmt_pct(hv(sc, "cvd_40q30_2050", tab), 1),
  qr  = fmt_pct(hv(sc, "cvd_40q30_pct_reduction_2050", tab), 1),
  dr  = fmt_pct(hv(sc, "pct_reduction_deaths_2050", tab), 1))
## The two DISCOUNTED per-capita measures for one scenario, reconstructed from the
## family's own cost workbook (see the national-cost-recon chunk):
##   pc1 = average annual additional cost per capita, 2026-2050
##       = cumulative discounted additional cost 2026-2050 / (25 x 2026 population)
##   pc2 = discounted additional cost per capita in 2050 / 2050 population
## Adaptive precision keeps cents-scale public-health costs from rounding to zero.
pc1 <- function(tab, sc) fmt_usd_pc2(pc_avg_annual(fam_of(tab), sc))
pc2 <- function(tab, sc) fmt_usd_pc2(pc_year2050(fam_of(tab), sc))
ce_row <- function(tab, sc) cbind(
  impact_row(tab, sc),
  data.table(cpd  = fmt_usd(hv(sc, "cost_per_death_averted", tab)),
             pc1c = pc1(tab, sc),
             pc2c = pc2(tab, sc)))

## Build a display table for a family's top-level rows, capped for space.
## Returns list(tb, agg_row_idx, n_omitted, omitted_labels).
family_table <- function(tab, agg_id, row_fun) {
  d <- top_level_rows(tab, agg_id)
  n_omitted <- 0L; omitted <- character(0)
  if (nrow(d) > MAX_TBL_ROWS) {
    keep_agg <- d[scenario == agg_id]
    body <- d[scenario != agg_id]
    n_keep <- MAX_TBL_ROWS - nrow(keep_agg)
    omitted <- body$scenario[-seq_len(min(n_keep, nrow(body)))]
    body <- body[seq_len(min(n_keep, nrow(body)))]
    d <- rbind(body, keep_agg)
    n_omitted <- length(omitted)
    message(sprintf("  Deck: family table capped at %d rows; %d intervention(s) omitted for space: %s",
                    MAX_TBL_ROWS, n_omitted, paste(omitted, collapse = ", ")))
  }
  if (!nrow(d)) return(list(tb = data.table(), agg_idx = NA_integer_, n_omitted = 0L, omitted = character(0)))
  tb <- rbindlist(lapply(d$scenario, function(s) row_fun(tab, s)))
  list(tb = tb, agg_idx = which(d$scenario == agg_id), n_omitted = n_omitted, omitted = omitted)
}
```

```{r national-cost-recon-undisc, include=FALSE}
## ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
## UNDISCOUNTED national cost measures - an exact parallel to national-cost-recon,
## reconstructed from EACH family's OWN cost workbook, keyed by scenario. This
## block leaves every discounted helper/object untouched and only ADDS the
## undiscounted analogues (suffix _undisc). Every workbook-specific rule is
## preserved: the same population denominators, coverage/implementation
## quantities, scenario identity, and shared-component de-duplication as the
## discounted path -- the ONLY change is that the per-year discount factor is
## omitted from the annual cost. Because the formula workbooks write ALL computed
## cost cells (discounted AND undiscounted) uncached, the reconstruction reads the
## same authoritative INPUT columns the workbook formulae use:
##   * clinical      -> the cached companion Budget_Impact stores incremental_cost
##                      (annual undiscounted) + cumulative_incremental_cost as literals.
##   * public-health -> annual undiscounted policy-implementation cost from Annual_Cost
##                      inputs (drop the 1/(1+r)^(t-y0) factor from the discounted build).
##   * combined      -> annual undiscounted additional cost from Annual_Cost inputs
##                      (same drop-the-discount-factor reconstruction).
## Each reconstruction is reconciled to the run's contract UNDISCOUNTED total
## (res$incremental_cost) to a tight relative tolerance -- the undiscounted twin of
## the discounted reconciliation. No Excel COM is required.
## ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
build_annual_cost_undisc <- function(fam) {
  if (fam == "clinical") {
    ## Cached clinical Budget_Impact stores undiscounted incremental_cost as literals.
    bi <- read_clin_bi()
    need <- c("scenario","year","incremental_cost","national_population","cumulative_incremental_cost")
    val_stop(all(need %in% names(bi)), "clinical Budget_Impact missing required undiscounted column(s)")
    .rc <- bi[, .(a = cumsum(incremental_cost), c = cumulative_incremental_cost), by = scenario]
    val_stop(max(abs(.rc$a - .rc$c)) < 1,
             "clinical annual undiscounted cost does not reconcile to the cumulative field")
    out <- bi[, .(scenario, year, undisc = incremental_cost, pop = national_population)]
  } else if (fam == "public_health") {
    ## Uncached: reproduce annual UNDISCOUNTED policy-implementation cost from Annual_Cost inputs.
    ps <- .ca_num(wb_ph, "policy_start_year");   rp <- .ca_num(wb_ph, "policy_cost_ramp_years")
    b0 <- .ca_num(wb_ph, "baseline_implementation_fraction")
    val_stop(all(is.finite(c(ps, rp))), "public-health cost assumptions (start/ramp) missing")
    if (!is.finite(b0)) b0 <- 0
    ac <- rd(wb_ph, "Annual_Cost")
    need <- c("scenario","year","pop_scenario","population_in_need_fraction","frequency_per_year","unit_cost_usd")
    val_stop(all(need %in% names(ac)), "public-health Annual_Cost missing required input column(s)")
    imf <- function(t) { f <- (t - (ps - 1)) / rp; f[t < ps] <- 0; pmin(pmax(f, 0), 1) }
    ac[, undisc := pop_scenario * population_in_need_fraction * frequency_per_year * unit_cost_usd *
                   (imf(year) - b0)]
    a  <- ac[, .(undisc = sum(undisc)), by = .(scenario, year)]
    bi <- rd(wb_ph, "Budget_Impact")
    val_stop("national_population" %in% names(bi), "public-health Budget_Impact missing national_population")
    out <- merge(a, bi[, .(scenario, year, pop = national_population)], by = c("scenario","year"))
  } else if (fam == "combined") {
    ## Uncached: reproduce annual UNDISCOUNTED additional cost from Annual_Cost inputs.
    ac <- rd(wb_comb, "Annual_Cost")
    need <- c("scenario","year","pin_fraction","frequency_per_year","unit_cost_usd",
              "q_scenario","q_baseline","covimpl_scenario","covimpl_baseline")
    val_stop(all(need %in% names(ac)), "combined Annual_Cost missing required input column(s)")
    ac[, undisc := pin_fraction * frequency_per_year * unit_cost_usd *
                   (q_scenario * covimpl_scenario - q_baseline * covimpl_baseline)]
    a  <- ac[, .(undisc = sum(undisc)), by = .(scenario, year)]
    bi <- rd(wb_comb, "Budget_Impact")
    val_stop("national_population" %in% names(bi), "combined Budget_Impact missing national_population")
    out <- merge(a, bi[, .(scenario, year, pop = national_population)], by = c("scenario","year"))
  } else stop("unknown family: ", fam)
  setorder(out, scenario, year)
  ## --- Structural validation (mirrors the discounted build) ---------------
  yrs <- sort(unique(out$year))
  val_stop(setequal(yrs, HZ_START:HZ_END),
           sprintf("%s undiscounted cost workbook year coverage is not %d-%d", fam, HZ_START, HZ_END))
  val_stop(nrow(out[, .(nu = uniqueN(pop)), by = year][nu > 1]) == 0,
           sprintf("%s national_population differs across scenarios within a year (undiscounted)", fam))
  ## reconcile reconstructed full-horizon total to the run's contract UNDISCOUNTED total
  ct <- res[workbook == fam, .(scenario, contract = incremental_cost)][is.finite(contract)]
  rc <- merge(out[, .(tot = sum(undisc)), by = scenario], ct, by = "scenario")
  rc[, rel := abs(tot - contract) / pmax(abs(contract), 1)]
  val_stop(nrow(rc) > 0 && max(rc$rel) < 1e-4,
           sprintf("%s reconstructed undiscounted cost does not reconcile to the contract total (max rel.diff %.2g)",
                   fam, if (nrow(rc)) max(rc$rel) else NA_real_))
  out[]
}
annual_cost_tabs_undisc <- list(
  clinical      = build_annual_cost_undisc("clinical"),
  public_health = build_annual_cost_undisc("public_health"),
  combined      = build_annual_cost_undisc("combined"))

## The two UNDISCOUNTED per-capita measures for one (family, scenario).
pc_avg_annual_undisc <- function(fam, sc) {                 # measure (1), undiscounted
  d <- annual_cost_tabs_undisc[[fam]][scenario == sc]
  if (!nrow(d)) return(NA_real_)
  num   <- d[year %in% DISPLAY_YEARS, sum(undisc)]
  pop26 <- d[year == HZ_START + 1L, pop][1]
  if (!is.finite(num) || !is.finite(pop26) || pop26 <= 0) return(NA_real_)
  num / (25 * pop26)
}
pc_year2050_undisc <- function(fam, sc) {                   # measure (2), undiscounted
  d <- annual_cost_tabs_undisc[[fam]][scenario == sc]
  if (!nrow(d)) return(NA_real_)
  u50 <- d[year == HZ_END, undisc][1]; pop50 <- d[year == HZ_END, pop][1]
  if (!is.finite(u50) || !is.finite(pop50) || pop50 <= 0) return(NA_real_)
  u50 / pop50
}
## Independent validation: measure (2) UNDISCOUNTED for the clinical family must equal
## the clinical workbook's own cached incremental_cost_per_capita in 2050.
{ .bi <- read_clin_bi()
  if ("incremental_cost_per_capita" %in% names(.bi)) {
    .chk <- .bi[year == HZ_END, .(scenario, stored = incremental_cost_per_capita)][is.finite(stored)]
    if (nrow(.chk)) {
      .cmp <- data.table(scenario = .chk$scenario, stored = .chk$stored,
                         rebuilt = vapply(.chk$scenario, function(s) pc_year2050_undisc("clinical", s), numeric(1)))
      val_stop(max(abs(.cmp$stored - .cmp$rebuilt)) < 1e-6,
               "clinical 2050 undiscounted per-capita reconstruction disagrees with the workbook's stored value") }
  }
}
```

```{r cascade-data, include=FALSE}
## ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
## 5. ISOLATED 70-30-30 -> 70-70-70 cascade strategy analysis. Read ONLY from
##    the cascade workbook's stored/literal values; never merged with the
##    ordinary results contract. Fail loudly on any structural surprise.
## ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
csh   <- openxlsx::getSheetNames(casc_wb)
.creq <- c("Run_Metadata","Scenario_Catalog","Cascade_Assumptions","Cascade_Trajectory",
           "Annual_Mortality","CVD_40q30","Annual_Cost","Budget_Impact","Cost_Effectiveness")
val_stop(all(.creq %in% csh),
         sprintf("cascade workbook missing sheet(s): %s", paste(setdiff(.creq, csh), collapse = ", ")))
cread <- function(s) as.data.table(openxlsx::read.xlsx(casc_wb, sheet = s))
need_cols <- function(dt, cols, sheet)
  val_stop(all(cols %in% names(dt)),
           sprintf("cascade sheet '%s' missing column(s): %s", sheet, paste(setdiff(cols, names(dt)), collapse = ", ")))

## Cached-value fallback for UNcached formula cells. The cascade FORMULA workbook is the
## structural + methodological source of truth, but openxlsx writes formula cells UNcached:
## its computed cost / cost-effectiveness columns read back as NA (Excel would populate them
## only on open). When a required numeric column is entirely non-finite, fall back to the
## companion literal-value workbook (indonesia_70_30_30_to_70_70_70_cost_value.xlsx) for ONLY
## that sheet's numbers; every structural sheet is still read from the formula workbook. The
## companion is used only after both workbooks are validated to describe the SAME run.
casc_wb_cached <- sub("_formulae\\.xlsx$", ".xlsx", casc_wb)
.casc_same_run <- FALSE
ensure_casc_same_run <- function() {
  if (.casc_same_run) return(invisible(TRUE))
  val_stop(file.exists(casc_wb_cached),
           sprintf("cascade formula workbook has uncached cost cells and its literal-value companion is missing: %s",
                   basename(casc_wb_cached)))
  ## (i) identical Annual_Cost row keys => same scenarios / interventions / years / cost keys.
  keyc <- c("scenario","year","cost_record_id","cost_component_key","cost_join_key")
  kf <- cread("Annual_Cost"); kc <- as.data.table(openxlsx::read.xlsx(casc_wb_cached, sheet = "Annual_Cost"))
  val_stop(all(keyc %in% names(kf)) && all(keyc %in% names(kc)),
           "cannot verify cascade formula/cached same-run: an Annual_Cost key column is missing")
  kfk <- sort(do.call(paste, c(kf[, ..keyc], sep = "")))
  kck <- sort(do.call(paste, c(kc[, ..keyc], sep = "")))
  val_stop(length(kfk) == length(kck) && all(kfk == kck),
           "cascade cached-value workbook does not match the formula workbook (different scenarios / interventions / years / cost keys)")
  ## (ii) matching run provenance metadata.
  mf <- cread("Run_Metadata"); mc <- as.data.table(openxlsx::read.xlsx(casc_wb_cached, sheet = "Run_Metadata"))
  for (it in c("Input workbook","Scenarios costed","Model / pipeline","Location")) {
    vf <- mf[item == it, value]; vc <- mc[item == it, value]
    val_stop(length(vf) && length(vc) && identical(vf[1], vc[1]),
             sprintf("cascade formula vs cached workbook disagree on Run_Metadata '%s' (different run)", it))
  }
  .casc_same_run <<- TRUE
  invisible(TRUE)
}
## Read a cascade sheet preferring the formula workbook; if any required numeric column is
## absent or entirely non-finite there (uncached formulas), take the sheet from the validated
## literal-value companion instead.
cread_num <- function(sheet, num_cols) {
  d <- cread(sheet)
  ok <- all(num_cols %in% names(d)) &&
        all(vapply(num_cols, function(cc) any(is.finite(d[[cc]])), logical(1)))
  if (ok) return(d)
  ensure_casc_same_run()
  as.data.table(openxlsx::read.xlsx(casc_wb_cached, sheet = sheet))
}

## (a) Exactly the two expected scenarios (baseline + the cascade scenario).
CASC_SCEN <- "S_70_30_30_TO_70_70_70"
c_cat <- cread("Scenario_Catalog"); need_cols(c_cat, "scenario", "Scenario_Catalog")
val_stop(setequal(c_cat$scenario, c("baseline", CASC_SCEN)),
         sprintf("cascade Scenario_Catalog must be exactly {baseline, %s}; got {%s}",
                 CASC_SCEN, paste(c_cat$scenario, collapse = ", ")))

## (b) Assumptions -> parameter lookup + metadata.
c_as <- cread("Cascade_Assumptions"); need_cols(c_as, c("parameter_id","value"), "Cascade_Assumptions")
getp  <- function(id) { v <- c_as[parameter_id == id, value][1]; val_stop(!is.na(v), sprintf("cascade assumption '%s' missing", id)); v }
getpn <- function(id) suppressWarnings(as.numeric(getp(id)))
casc_disc  <- getpn("cost_discount_rate")
casc_price <- getpn("cost_price_year")
casc_curr  <- getp("currency")
casc_diag  <- getpn("target_diagnosis_share")
casc_t30   <- getpn("first_target_treatment_conditional")
casc_c30   <- getpn("first_target_control_conditional")
casc_t40   <- getpn("final_target_treatment_conditional")
casc_c40   <- getpn("final_target_control_conditional")
casc_half  <- getpn("treated_uncontrolled_effect_fraction")
casc_eff30 <- getpn("first_target_effective_coverage_exact")
casc_eff40 <- getpn("final_target_effective_coverage_exact")
casc_y0    <- as.integer(getpn("analysis_start_year"))
casc_y1    <- as.integer(getpn("analysis_end_year"))
casc_ytar1 <- as.integer(getpn("first_target_year"))
casc_ytar2 <- as.integer(getpn("final_target_year"))
c_meta <- cread("Run_Metadata")
casc_persp <- { v <- c_meta[item == "Economic perspective", value]; ltx(gsub("_", " ", if (length(v)) v[1] else "health system")) }
val_stop(is.finite(casc_disc) && is.finite(casc_price), "cascade discount rate / price year missing")
## Nested-share + effective-coverage reconciliation (fail loud if the workbook drifts).
val_stop(abs(casc_diag * casc_t30 * casc_c30 - 0.063) < 1e-6, "cascade 2030 controlled share does not reconcile to 6.3%")
val_stop(abs(casc_diag * casc_t40 * casc_c40 - 0.343) < 1e-6, "cascade 2040 controlled share does not reconcile to 34.3%")
.eff_cov <- function(diag, t, ctrl, half) diag * t * ctrl + half * (diag * t - diag * t * ctrl)
val_stop(abs(.eff_cov(casc_diag, casc_t30, casc_c30, casc_half) - casc_eff30) < 1e-6,
         "cascade 2030 effective coverage does not reconcile to the stored exact value")
val_stop(abs(.eff_cov(casc_diag, casc_t40, casc_c40, casc_half) - casc_eff40) < 1e-6,
         "cascade 2040 effective coverage does not reconcile to the stored exact value")

## (c) Hypertension cascade shares (sex-averaged) for the bar figure.
c_tr <- cread("Cascade_Trajectory")
need_cols(c_tr, c("intervention_id","risk_factor_id","sex","year","controlled_share","treated_uncontrolled_share"), "Cascade_Trajectory")
htn_shares <- function(iv, rf) {
  d <- c_tr[intervention_id == iv & risk_factor_id == rf & year %in% c(HZ_START, casc_ytar1, casc_ytar2) &
              !is.na(controlled_share)]
  d[, treated := controlled_share + treated_uncontrolled_share]
  d[, .(controlled = mean(controlled_share), treated = mean(treated)), by = year][order(year)]
}
htn_sh <- htn_shares("I_CVD_PRIMARY", "RF_HTN")
val_stop(nrow(htn_sh) == 3L, "hypertension cascade needs baseline + two milestone years of shares")
## diagnosed row: not modelled at baseline (leave NA); = target at milestone years
htn_sh[, diagnosed := ifelse(year == HZ_START, NA_real_, casc_diag)]
dm_base <- { d <- c_tr[intervention_id == "I_T2D_TREATMENT" & year == HZ_START & !is.na(controlled_share)]
             d[, treated := controlled_share + treated_uncontrolled_share]
             list(treated = mean(d$treated), controlled = mean(d$controlled_share)) }

## (d) Probability-of-death-before-70 series (R-reconciled literal values).
c_q <- cread("CVD_40q30"); need_cols(c_q, c("scenario","year","cvd_40q30_r"), "CVD_40q30")
casc_q <- c_q[, .(scenario, year, q = cvd_40q30_r)][order(scenario, year)]
val_stop(all(is.finite(casc_q$q)) && setequal(casc_q$year, casc_y0:casc_y1),
         "cascade probability-of-death series has gaps or non-finite values")

## (e) Cumulative DISCOUNTED cost levels (baseline vs intervention), de-duplicated.
c_ac <- cread_num("Annual_Cost", c("disc_cost_baseline","disc_cost_scenario","disc_cost_incremental"))
need_cols(c_ac, c("year","disc_cost_baseline","disc_cost_scenario","disc_cost_incremental"), "Annual_Cost")
## Count each shared component once. The formula workbook carries an explicit
## shared_duplicate_count; the literal-value companion omits it (its rows are already the
## de-duplicated set -- each component appears exactly once per year), so a missing/NA count
## is treated as 1. Any residual double-count is still caught by the Budget_Impact
## reconciliation guard below.
if (!"shared_duplicate_count" %in% names(c_ac) || all(is.na(c_ac$shared_duplicate_count)))
  c_ac[, shared_duplicate_count := 1]
c_ac[, w := 1 / pmax(shared_duplicate_count, 1)]              # count shared components once
casc_cost <- c_ac[, .(base = sum(disc_cost_baseline * w), scen = sum(disc_cost_scenario * w),
                      inc  = sum(disc_cost_incremental * w)), by = year][order(year)]
casc_cost[, `:=`(cum_base = cumsum(base), cum_scen = cumsum(scen), cum_inc = cumsum(inc))]
c_bi <- cread_num("Budget_Impact", c("cumulative_disc_incremental_cost","disc_incremental_cost"))
need_cols(c_bi, c("year","cumulative_disc_incremental_cost","disc_incremental_cost","national_population"), "Budget_Impact")
casc_cost <- merge(casc_cost, c_bi[, .(year, bi_cum = cumulative_disc_incremental_cost,
                                       bi_disc_annual = disc_incremental_cost,
                                       bi_pop = national_population)], by = "year")
## ANNUAL (year-specific, NOT cumulative) additional cost per capita = that year's
## discounted additional cost / that year's national population (both authoritative
## Budget_Impact fields). Distinct from the 2026-2050 average shown in the CE tables.
casc_cost[, pc_annual := bi_disc_annual / bi_pop]
val_stop(all(is.finite(casc_cost$pc_annual)), "cascade annual per-capita cost is non-finite")
## Guard: our de-duplicated level difference must reconcile to the authoritative budget sheet.
val_stop(max(abs((casc_cost$cum_scen - casc_cost$cum_base) - casc_cost$bi_cum)) < 1,
         "cascade cost levels (Annual_Cost) do not reconcile to Budget_Impact cumulative additional cost")

## (f) Cumulative deaths (six CVD causes + type-2 diabetes), baseline vs intervention.
c_am <- cread("Annual_Mortality"); need_cols(c_am, c("scenario","year","cause_deaths","base_deaths","deaths_averted"), "Annual_Mortality")
casc_base_d <- c_am[scenario == "baseline",  .(base = sum(cause_deaths)), by = year][order(year)]
casc_scen_d <- c_am[scenario == CASC_SCEN,   .(scen = sum(cause_deaths)), by = year][order(year)]
casc_deaths <- merge(casc_base_d, casc_scen_d, by = "year")
casc_deaths[, `:=`(cum_base = cumsum(base), cum_scen = cumsum(scen))]
casc_deaths[, cum_averted := cum_base - cum_scen]

## (g) Headline metrics from the workbook Cost_Effectiveness (single source of truth).
c_ce <- cread_num("Cost_Effectiveness", c("deaths_averted","disc_incremental_cost","cost_per_death_averted")); need_cols(c_ce, c("scenario","deaths_averted","disc_incremental_cost","cost_per_death_averted"), "Cost_Effectiveness")
c_ce <- c_ce[scenario == CASC_SCEN]
val_stop(nrow(c_ce) == 1L, "cascade Cost_Effectiveness must have exactly the cascade scenario")
casc_da   <- c_ce$deaths_averted[1]
casc_cost_tot <- c_ce$disc_incremental_cost[1]
casc_cpda <- c_ce$cost_per_death_averted[1]
## Reconcile CE against the annual sheets we plotted (fail loud on drift).
val_stop(abs(casc_deaths[year == casc_y1, cum_averted] - casc_da) < 1,
         "cascade deaths averted (Annual_Mortality) do not reconcile to Cost_Effectiveness")
val_stop(abs(casc_cost[year == casc_y1, bi_cum] - casc_cost_tot) < 1e4,
         "cascade cumulative additional cost (Budget_Impact) does not reconcile to Cost_Effectiveness")

## Cumulative snapshots for the results table (2030 / 2040 / 2050).
casc_tab_years <- c(casc_ytar1, casc_ytar2, casc_y1)
casc_snapshot <- function(y) list(
  d_base = casc_deaths[year == y, cum_base], d_scen = casc_deaths[year == y, cum_scen],
  d_av   = casc_deaths[year == y, cum_averted],
  c_base = casc_cost[year == y, cum_base],   c_scen = casc_cost[year == y, cum_scen],
  c_add  = casc_cost[year == y, bi_cum],
  pc_ann = casc_cost[year == y, pc_annual])   # year-specific annual additional cost per capita
```

```{r cascade-data-undisc, include=FALSE}
## ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
## UNDISCOUNTED cascade cost levels -- an exact parallel to the (e)/(g) blocks of
## cascade-data, ADDED alongside the discounted objects (never replacing them).
## The cascade FORMULA workbook is the structural source of truth but writes its
## computed cost cells uncached, so cread_num() transparently takes the numbers
## from the validated literal-value companion (same-run guarded). The undiscounted
## build reuses the SAME de-duplication rule (count each shared component once) and
## the SAME authoritative Budget_Impact fields as the discounted build; the ONLY
## difference is that it sums the undiscounted annual_cost_* columns instead of the
## discounted disc_cost_* columns, and reconciles to the workbook's UNDISCOUNTED
## cumulative_incremental_cost / Cost_Effectiveness incremental_cost.
c_ac_u <- cread_num("Annual_Cost", c("annual_cost_baseline","annual_cost_scenario","annual_cost_incremental"))
need_cols(c_ac_u, c("year","annual_cost_baseline","annual_cost_scenario","annual_cost_incremental"), "Annual_Cost")
if (!"shared_duplicate_count" %in% names(c_ac_u) || all(is.na(c_ac_u$shared_duplicate_count)))
  c_ac_u[, shared_duplicate_count := 1]
c_ac_u[, w := 1 / pmax(shared_duplicate_count, 1)]           # count shared components once
casc_cost_u <- c_ac_u[, .(base = sum(annual_cost_baseline * w), scen = sum(annual_cost_scenario * w),
                          inc  = sum(annual_cost_incremental * w)), by = year][order(year)]
casc_cost_u[, `:=`(cum_base = cumsum(base), cum_scen = cumsum(scen), cum_inc = cumsum(inc))]
c_bi_u <- cread_num("Budget_Impact", c("cumulative_incremental_cost","incremental_cost"))
need_cols(c_bi_u, c("year","cumulative_incremental_cost","incremental_cost","national_population"), "Budget_Impact")
casc_cost_u <- merge(casc_cost_u, c_bi_u[, .(year, bi_cum = cumulative_incremental_cost,
                                             bi_ann = incremental_cost, bi_pop = national_population)], by = "year")
## ANNUAL (year-specific, NOT cumulative) undiscounted additional cost per capita.
casc_cost_u[, pc_annual := bi_ann / bi_pop]
val_stop(all(is.finite(casc_cost_u$pc_annual)), "cascade annual undiscounted per-capita cost is non-finite")
## de-duplicated level difference must reconcile to the authoritative UNDISCOUNTED budget sheet.
val_stop(max(abs((casc_cost_u$cum_scen - casc_cost_u$cum_base) - casc_cost_u$bi_cum)) < 1,
         "cascade undiscounted cost levels do not reconcile to Budget_Impact cumulative additional cost")

## Undiscounted headline metrics from the workbook Cost_Effectiveness (single source of truth).
c_ce_u <- cread_num("Cost_Effectiveness", c("deaths_averted","incremental_cost"))
c_ce_u <- c_ce_u[scenario == CASC_SCEN]
val_stop(nrow(c_ce_u) == 1L, "cascade undiscounted Cost_Effectiveness must have exactly the cascade scenario")
casc_cost_tot_undisc <- c_ce_u$incremental_cost[1]
casc_cpda_undisc <- if (is.finite(casc_da) && casc_da > 0) casc_cost_tot_undisc / casc_da else NA_real_
val_stop(abs(casc_cost_u[year == casc_y1, bi_cum] - casc_cost_tot_undisc) < 1e4,
         "cascade cumulative undiscounted additional cost does not reconcile to Cost_Effectiveness")

## Undiscounted cumulative snapshots for the results table (2030 / 2040 / 2050).
casc_snapshot_undisc <- function(y) list(
  d_base = casc_deaths[year == y, cum_base], d_scen = casc_deaths[year == y, cum_scen],
  d_av   = casc_deaths[year == y, cum_averted],
  c_base = casc_cost_u[year == y, cum_base], c_scen = casc_cost_u[year == y, cum_scen],
  c_add  = casc_cost_u[year == y, bi_cum],
  pc_ann = casc_cost_u[year == y, pc_annual])   # year-specific annual undiscounted additional cost per capita
```

```{r deck-titles, include=FALSE}
title_exec <- if (has_joint)
  sprintf("Together, clinical care and prevention could avert about %s deaths by %d",
          fmt_title_num(combo_da), HZ_END) else
  "Clinical care and population prevention each cut premature cardiovascular deaths"
title_cascade_results <- sprintf(
  "A stronger cascade could prevent about %s deaths by %d",
  fmt_title_num(casc_da), casc_y1)

## UNDISCOUNTED-counterpart takeaway titles (plain text; no %/$). Each states the

title_exec_undisc <- if (has_joint)
  sprintf("Without discounting, combining care and prevention still averts about %s deaths by %d",
          fmt_title_num(combo_da), HZ_END) else
  "Without discounting, clinical care and prevention each still cut premature cardiovascular deaths"
title_cascade_results_undisc <- sprintf(
  "On an undiscounted basis, a stronger cascade still prevents about %s deaths by %d",
  fmt_title_num(casc_da), casc_y1)
```

```{r subnat-data, include=FALSE}
## ===========================================================================
## ISOLATED SUBNATIONAL (38-province) 70-30-30 -> 70-70-70 cascade analysis.
## Read ONLY from the province-level cascade workbook; never merged with any other
## results. Formula-only fields are reproduced from cached authoritative inputs
## (validated on the fully-cached national cascade workbook); population is the
## workbook's own province_population.
## ===========================================================================
sread <- function(s) as.data.table(openxlsx::read.xlsx(subnat_wb, sheet = s))
.ssh  <- openxlsx::getSheetNames(subnat_wb)
.sreq <- c("Run_Metadata","Cascade_Assumptions","Scenario_Catalog","Cascade_Trajectory",
           "Annual_Mortality","Health_Outcomes","CVD_40q30","Annual_Cost","Budget_Impact",
           "Cost_Effectiveness","Province_Reconciliation")
val_stop(all(.sreq %in% .ssh),
         sprintf("subnational workbook missing sheet(s): %s", paste(setdiff(.sreq, .ssh), collapse = ", ")))
sneed <- function(dt, cols, sheet)
  val_stop(all(cols %in% names(dt)),
           sprintf("subnational sheet '%s' missing column(s): %s", sheet, paste(setdiff(cols, names(dt)), collapse = ", ")))

## Exactly the baseline + cascade scenario.
SUB_SCEN <- "S_70_30_30_TO_70_70_70"
s_cat <- sread("Scenario_Catalog"); sneed(s_cat, "scenario", "Scenario_Catalog")
val_stop(setequal(s_cat$scenario, c("baseline", SUB_SCEN)),
         sprintf("subnational Scenario_Catalog must be exactly {baseline, %s}", SUB_SCEN))

## Assumptions + metadata.
s_as <- sread("Cascade_Assumptions"); sneed(s_as, c("parameter_id","value"), "Cascade_Assumptions")
sgetn <- function(id) suppressWarnings(as.numeric(s_as[parameter_id == id, value][1]))
sub_disc  <- sgetn("cost_discount_rate"); sub_y0 <- as.integer(sgetn("analysis_start_year"))
sub_price <- as.integer(sgetn("cost_price_year"))
sub_ytar1 <- as.integer(sgetn("first_target_year")); sub_ytar2 <- as.integer(sgetn("final_target_year"))
sub_eff30 <- sgetn("first_target_effective_coverage_exact")
sub_eff40 <- sgetn("final_target_effective_coverage_exact")
val_stop(all(is.finite(c(sub_disc, sub_y0, sub_ytar1, sub_ytar2))), "subnational assumptions missing")
s_rmd <- sread("Run_Metadata")
sub_persp <- { v <- s_rmd[item == "Economic perspective", value]; ltx(gsub("_", " ", if (length(v)) v[1] else "health system")) }

## ---- Province roster + BPS(province_code) -> ISO-3166-2 crosswalk -----------
## The offline boundary set (rnaturalearth admin-1) predates the 5 post-2012
## provinces (North Kalimantan; the four new Papua provinces); each is mapped onto
## its PARENT polygon, of which it is an exact geographic subset. Counts are summed
## and rates are population-weighted onto the parent, so the parent region is
## reconstituted exactly. All 38 provinces are shown individually in the Pareto bar.
s_ce <- sread("Cost_Effectiveness"); sneed(s_ce, c("location","province_code"), "Cost_Effectiveness")
prov_meta <- unique(s_ce[, .(location, province_code = as.character(province_code))])
val_stop(uniqueN(prov_meta$location) == 38L && nrow(prov_meta) == 38L,
         sprintf("expected exactly 38 unique provinces; got %d rows / %d locations",
                 nrow(prov_meta), uniqueN(prov_meta$location)))
bps2iso <- c(
  "11"="ID-AC","12"="ID-SU","13"="ID-SB","14"="ID-RI","15"="ID-JA","16"="ID-SS","17"="ID-BE",
  "18"="ID-LA","19"="ID-BB","21"="ID-KR","31"="ID-JK","32"="ID-JB","33"="ID-JT","34"="ID-YO",
  "35"="ID-JI","36"="ID-BT","51"="ID-BA","52"="ID-NB","53"="ID-NT","61"="ID-KB","62"="ID-KT",
  "63"="ID-KS","64"="ID-KI","65"="ID-KI","71"="ID-SA","72"="ID-ST","73"="ID-SN","74"="ID-SG",
  "75"="ID-GO","76"="ID-SR","81"="ID-MA","82"="ID-MU","91"="ID-PA","92"="ID-PB","93"="ID-PA",
  "94"="ID-PA","95"="ID-PA","96"="ID-PB")
prov_meta[, iso := bps2iso[province_code]]
val_stop(!any(is.na(prov_meta$iso)),
         sprintf("province(s) without a boundary mapping: %s", paste(prov_meta[is.na(iso), location], collapse = ", ")))
n_merged_prov <- nrow(prov_meta[, .N, by = iso][N > 1][, .(iso)])   # parent polygons receiving >1 province
n_new_prov    <- sum(prov_meta$province_code %in% c("65","93","94","95","96"))

## Province population by year (authoritative; cached) for weighting/denominators.
s_bi <- sread("Budget_Impact"); sneed(s_bi, c("location","year","province_population"), "Budget_Impact")
prov_pop <- s_bi[, .(location, year, pop = province_population)]

## ---- (5a) Cumulative deaths averted by province, 2025-2050 (6 CVD + T2D) ----
s_ho <- sread("Health_Outcomes"); sneed(s_ho, c("location","scenario","year","modeled_deaths","baseline_deaths"), "Health_Outcomes")
da_prov <- s_ho[scenario == SUB_SCEN, .(da = sum(baseline_deaths - modeled_deaths)), by = location]
val_stop(nrow(da_prov) == 38L && all(is.finite(da_prov$da)), "subnational deaths averted incomplete")
setorder(da_prov, -da)
da_prov[, cum_share := cumsum(da) / sum(da) * 100]
da_prov[, location := factor(location, levels = location)]        # sorted order for the Pareto
sub_da_total <- sum(da_prov$da)
## Reconcile baseline-death aggregation to the workbook's Province_Reconciliation.
s_pr <- sread("Province_Reconciliation"); sneed(s_pr, c("metric","province_sum","national","rel_diff","status"), "Province_Reconciliation")
.prd <- s_pr[grepl("baseline_modeled_deaths", metric)]
sub_recon_reldiff <- if (nrow(.prd)) suppressWarnings(as.numeric(.prd$rel_diff[1])) * 100 else NA_real_
sub_recon_status  <- if (nrow(.prd)) .prd$status[1] else NA_character_

## ---- (5b) CVD primary-care effective coverage, 2025 & 2040 (sex-pooled) -----
s_tr <- sread("Cascade_Trajectory")
sneed(s_tr, c("location","intervention_id","sex","year","scenario_effective_coverage"), "Cascade_Trajectory")
cvp <- s_tr[intervention_id == "I_CVD_PRIMARY" & year %in% c(HZ_START, sub_ytar2)]
## Verify the two sexes are identical at the 70-70-70 target year (so the pooled mean is exact there).
.sxchk <- dcast(cvp[year == sub_ytar2], location ~ sex, value.var = "scenario_effective_coverage")
val_stop(max(abs(.sxchk[[2]] - .sxchk[[3]])) < 1e-9,
         "subnational CVD coverage: the two sexes are not identical at the target year")
cov_prov <- cvp[, .(cov = mean(scenario_effective_coverage)), by = .(location, year)]  # equal adult-population weights

## ---- (5c) % reduction in CVD deaths (six CVD causes; exclude T2D), 2030/2040 -
s_am <- sread("Annual_Mortality"); sneed(s_am, c("location","scenario","year","cause","cause_deaths","base_deaths"), "Annual_Mortality")
CVD_CAUSES <- c("cmd","hhd","hstroke","ihd","istroke","rhd")   # six modelled CVD causes (no dm2)
val_stop(all(CVD_CAUSES %in% unique(s_am$cause)), "subnational Annual_Mortality missing a CVD cause code")
cvd_red <- s_am[scenario == SUB_SCEN & cause %in% CVD_CAUSES & year %in% c(sub_ytar1, sub_ytar2),
                .(base = sum(base_deaths), scen = sum(cause_deaths)), by = .(location, year)]
cvd_red[, pctred := (base - scen) / base * 100]

## ---- (5d) % reduction in probability of CVD death before age 70, 2030/2040 --
s_q <- sread("CVD_40q30"); sneed(s_q, c("location","scenario","year","cvd_40q30_r"), "CVD_40q30")
qb <- s_q[scenario == "baseline",  .(location, year, base_r = cvd_40q30_r)]
qs <- s_q[scenario == SUB_SCEN,    .(location, year, scen_r = cvd_40q30_r)]
q40 <- merge(qb, qs, by = c("location","year"))
val_stop(all(is.finite(q40$base_r)) && all(is.finite(q40$scen_r)) && all(q40$base_r > 0),
         "subnational probability-of-death series has gaps or non-positive baseline")
q40[, pctred := (base_r - scen_r) / base_r * 100]
q40 <- q40[year %in% c(sub_ytar1, sub_ytar2)]

## ---- (5e) Annual DISCOUNTED additional cost per capita, 2030 & 2040 ---------
## Reproduce annual discounted additional cost from cached Annual_Cost inputs
## (formula validated to machine precision on the national cascade workbook).
s_ac <- sread("Annual_Cost")
sneed(s_ac, c("location","scenario","year","frequency_per_year","unit_cost_usd","population_in_need_fraction",
              "r_quantity_scenario","r_quantity_baseline"), "Annual_Cost")
s_ac[, disc := frequency_per_year * unit_cost_usd * population_in_need_fraction *
       (r_quantity_scenario * coverage_scenario - r_quantity_baseline * coverage_baseline) *
       (1 / (1 + sub_disc)^(year - sub_y0))]
cost_prov <- s_ac[, .(disc = sum(disc)), by = .(location, year)]
cost_prov <- merge(cost_prov, prov_pop, by = c("location","year"))
cost_prov[, pc := disc / pop]
cost_prov <- cost_prov[year %in% c(sub_ytar1, sub_ytar2)]
val_stop(all(is.finite(cost_prov$pc)), "subnational per-capita cost has non-finite values")

## Each map-year dataset must cover all 38 provinces exactly once before plotting.
chk38 <- function(dt, yrs, what) for (y in yrs) {
  n <- uniqueN(dt[year == y, location])
  val_stop(n == 38L && !any(duplicated(dt[year == y, location])),
           sprintf("%s: year %d has %d unique provinces (expected 38)", what, y, n))
}
chk38(cov_prov,  c(HZ_START, sub_ytar2), "coverage map")
chk38(cvd_red,   c(sub_ytar1, sub_ytar2), "CVD-death reduction map")
chk38(q40,       c(sub_ytar1, sub_ytar2), "probability-of-death reduction map")
chk38(cost_prov, c(sub_ytar1, sub_ytar2), "per-capita cost map")

## ---- Boundary geometry (offline: rnaturalearth admin-1) + join validation ---
val_stop(requireNamespace("sf", quietly = TRUE) && requireNamespace("rnaturalearth", quietly = TRUE),
         "packages 'sf' and 'rnaturalearth' are required for the subnational maps")
suppressWarnings(suppressMessages({ library(sf); library(rnaturalearth) }))
idn_sf <- rnaturalearth::ne_states(country = "Indonesia", returnclass = "sf")
idn_sf <- idn_sf[, c("iso_3166_2", "name")]; names(idn_sf)[1] <- "iso"
val_stop(all(prov_meta$iso %in% idn_sf$iso),
         sprintf("boundary geometry is missing polygon(s) for iso: %s",
                 paste(setdiff(unique(prov_meta$iso), idn_sf$iso), collapse = ", ")))
n_polygons <- nrow(idn_sf)

## Aggregation helpers province -> boundary polygon (iso).
sum_to_iso <- function(dt, valcol) {           # counts: sum
  d <- merge(dt, prov_meta[, .(location, iso)], by = "location")
  d[, .(value = sum(get(valcol))), by = iso]
}
popw_to_iso <- function(dt, valcol, yr) {      # rates: population-weighted mean at year yr
  w <- prov_pop[year == yr, .(location, pop)]
  d <- merge(dt, prov_meta[, .(location, iso)], by = "location")
  d <- merge(d, w, by = "location")
  d[, .(value = sum(get(valcol) * pop) / sum(pop)), by = iso]
}
ratio_to_iso <- function(dt) {                 # per-capita cost: sum(cost)/sum(pop)
  d <- merge(dt, prov_meta[, .(location, iso)], by = "location")
  d[, .(value = sum(disc) / sum(pop)), by = iso]
}
## Attach values (one row per iso) to geometry, returning an sf for one panel/year.
map_sf <- function(iso_dt) {
  iso_df <- as.data.frame(iso_dt)                     # plain frame -> use merge.sf, not data.table
  m <- merge(idn_sf, iso_df, by = "iso", all.x = TRUE)
  val_stop(!any(is.na(m$value)), "a boundary polygon received no value in a subnational map")
  m
}
## Build a faceted two-year sf: bind per-year sf with a 'panel' label.
maps_two_year <- function(dt_by_year, years, panel_labs, agg = c("sum","popw","ratio"), valcol = "value") {
  agg <- match.arg(agg)
  out <- lapply(seq_along(years), function(i) {
    yr <- years[i]
    dyr <- dt_by_year[year == yr]
    iso_dt <- switch(agg,
                     sum   = sum_to_iso(dyr, valcol),
                     popw  = popw_to_iso(dyr, valcol, yr),
                     ratio = ratio_to_iso(dyr))
    s <- map_sf(iso_dt); s$panel <- panel_labs[i]; s
  })
  do.call(rbind, out)
}
## Common map theme.
theme_map_exec <- function(base = 10) {
  theme_void(base_size = base) +
    theme(legend.position = "bottom",
          legend.title = element_text(size = base - 2, colour = col_wbnavy),
          legend.text  = element_text(size = base - 3),
          legend.key.height = unit(0.28, "cm"), legend.key.width = unit(0.95, "cm"),
          strip.text = element_text(face = "bold", colour = col_wbnavy, size = base),
          plot.margin = margin(2, 2, 2, 2))
}

## ---- Common positive-anchored scale limits for the subnational choropleths -----
## Continuous colour bars must start at the minimum strictly-positive displayed value
## (no detached 0%/US$0 tick). Zeros/negatives are squished to the low end (see each
## map's oob=scales::squish) rather than dropped to NA/grey. Guards the degenerate
## all-non-positive / single-value cases. Applied to ALL subnational 70-70-70 maps.
pos_scale_lims <- function(v) {
  f <- v[is.finite(v)]
  if (!length(f)) return(c(0, 1))
  p  <- f[f > 0]
  lo <- if (length(p)) min(p) else min(f)
  hi <- max(f)
  if (!is.finite(hi) || hi <= lo) hi <- lo + abs(lo) * 1e-6 + 1e-9
  c(lo, hi)
}
```

```{r subnat-data-undisc, include=FALSE}
## ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
## UNDISCOUNTED subnational annual additional cost per capita -- an exact parallel
## to block (5e) of subnat-data, ADDED alongside the discounted objects. The
## discounted per-row cost s_ac$disc is already reproduced from the cached
## Annual_Cost inputs (formula validated to machine precision on the national
## cascade workbook); the undiscounted twin is the SAME reconstruction with the
## 1/(1+r)^(t-y0) discount factor omitted -- nothing else changes (same population
## denominator province_population, same coverage/quantity inputs, same de-dup).
s_ac[, undisc := frequency_per_year * unit_cost_usd * population_in_need_fraction *
       (r_quantity_scenario * coverage_scenario - r_quantity_baseline * coverage_baseline)]
## Internal identity: the undiscounted series is exactly the discounted one without
## the discount factor (fail loud if the reconstruction drifted).
.nz_u <- s_ac[abs(undisc) > 1e-9]
val_stop(max(abs(.nz_u$disc / .nz_u$undisc - 1 / (1 + sub_disc)^(.nz_u$year - sub_y0))) < 1e-6,
         "subnational undiscounted cost is not the discounted series without the discount factor")
cost_prov_u <- s_ac[, .(undisc = sum(undisc)), by = .(location, year)]
cost_prov_u <- merge(cost_prov_u, prov_pop, by = c("location", "year"))
cost_prov_u[, pc := undisc / pop]
cost_prov_u <- cost_prov_u[year %in% c(sub_ytar1, sub_ytar2)]
val_stop(all(is.finite(cost_prov_u$pc)), "subnational undiscounted per-capita cost has non-finite values")
chk38(cost_prov_u, c(sub_ytar1, sub_ytar2), "undiscounted per-capita cost map")
title_sub_cost_undisc <- "The undiscounted provincial financing requirement grows as coverage scales up"
```

# The challenge, and the opportunity

## Most premature cardiovascular deaths in Indonesia can be prevented or treated

\begin{columns}[T]
\begin{column}{0.52\textwidth}
\begin{block}{Cardiovascular disease is Indonesia's largest health burden}
\normalsize
Under current trends, a person reaching age 30 faces roughly a
\hlkey{`r fmt_pct(base_q_2025,1)` chance} of dying from cardiovascular disease
before age 70. Most of this is \textbf{preventable or treatable}.
\end{block}
\end{column}
\begin{column}{0.46\textwidth}
\begin{itemize}\itemsep4pt
  \item Premature CVD deaths (ages 30--69) have risen for two decades and remain high.
  \item Two complementary levers:
  \begin{itemize}
    \item \textcolor{clinicalcol}{\textbf{Clinical care}} --- prevent and better treat established disease.
    \item \textcolor{phcol}{\textbf{Population prevention}} --- tobacco, salt, trans-fat.
  \end{itemize}
  \item This analysis weighs their \textbf{health impact and value for money} together.
\end{itemize}
\end{column}
\end{columns}

\srcmethod{\textbf{Source:} Indonesia CVD model, calibrated to GBD 2023 and UN World Population Prospects 2024; combined results workbook (annual probability-of-death sheet). \textbf{Method:} the probability of death from CVD before age 70 is the chance of dying from the six modelled cardiovascular diseases between exact ages 30 and 70, read from a single-year life table in the `r HZ_START` baseline year.}

## We measured the health gains and the value for money of proven interventions

\begin{block}{General aim}
\normalsize Estimate the \textbf{health impact and value for money} of scaling up evidence-based
\textbf{clinical} and \textbf{public-health} cardiovascular interventions in Indonesia through \textbf{2050}.
\end{block}

\vspace{2pt}
\begin{columns}[T]
\begin{column}{0.33\textwidth}
\begin{clinicalblock}{Aim 1 --- Burden}
\footnotesize Project the CVD burden and the probability of death from CVD before age 70 under the \textbf{current course} and under \textbf{alternative intervention scenarios}.
\end{clinicalblock}
\end{column}
\begin{column}{0.33\textwidth}
\begin{phblock}{Aim 2 --- Value for money}
\footnotesize Estimate \textbf{deaths averted}, mortality reductions, \textbf{additional costs}, and the \textbf{cost per death averted} for each intervention and package.
\end{phblock}
\end{column}
\begin{column}{0.33\textwidth}
\begin{combinedblock}{Aim 3 --- Better together}
\footnotesize Quantify the \textbf{added value of combining} clinical and public-health action, modelled as a single joint run rather than a sum.
\end{combinedblock}
\end{column}
\end{columns}

\srcmethod{\textbf{Source:} study design; Indonesia CVD model. \textbf{Method:} every scenario runs through one projection over `r HZ_START`--`r HZ_END`; the baseline (current course) is the no-new-intervention comparator against which each scenario is measured.}

## The model follows how prevention and treatment change disease and survival

\begin{columns}[T]
\begin{column}{0.54\textwidth}
\footnotesize
\begin{enumerate}\itemsep3pt
  \item \textbf{People \& demography.} Indonesia's population is projected by age and sex (UN World Population Prospects 2024).
  \item \textbf{Starting health.} Disease and death rates are set to Indonesia's data (GBD 2023) and calibrated to match observed levels.
  \item \textbf{Year-by-year simulation.} Each year people can develop cardiovascular disease or diabetes, survive, or die.
  \item \textbf{Interventions.} Clinical and public-health scenarios change how many people develop disease (new cases) and how many survive it.
  \item \textbf{Outcomes.} The model reports deaths, healthy years lost or gained (DALYs), the probability of death from CVD before age 70, costs, and value for money.
\end{enumerate}
\end{column}
\begin{column}{0.44\textwidth}
\begin{block}{One consistent engine}
\footnotesize Every scenario runs through the \textbf{same} projection, so results are directly comparable and the \textbf{combined} package is modelled as one run --- not a sum of separate estimates.
\end{block}
\end{column}
\end{columns}

\srcmethod{\textbf{Source:} Indonesia CVD model engine; GBD 2023 (starting rates); UN World Population Prospects 2024 (demography, life expectancy). \textbf{Method:} a discrete-time state-transition simulation by single-year age and sex, calibrated to match observed GBD levels using a standard numerical optimiser.}

## Interventions work by preventing new disease and by helping people survive it
